jobs.title: Program & Project Coordinator (5257C), Bakar ClimatEnginuity Hub - #89253
jobs.description:
Program & Project Coordinator (5257C), Bakar ClimatEnginuity Hub - #89253 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Bakar Labs is the consortium of biotech and climate tech incubators made up of four locations: Bakar Bio Labs at Berkeley, Bakar Bio Labs at UCSF, Bakar Labs for Energy and Materials, and the IGI-Bakar Labs Expansion.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials expands towards opening a new incubator facility in mid-2028, the Program & Project Coordinator works closely with a team of three to provide entrepreneurship programming and recruit early-stage energy and materials companies for a pilot program. This position applies project management and analytical skills to oversee the day-to-day administration and execution of Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials initiatives, including fellowship programs, events, workshops, and campus/industry partnerships.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 16, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Operations & Administration - 35%
  
  
Manages day-to-day operational coordination of Bakar Labs programs, including developing and maintaining program systems, tracking milestones and deliverables, organizing scheduling across multiple concurrent activities, and managing founder and participant communications. Proactively identifies operational bottlenecks and implements process improvements to enhance program efficiency and participant experience.
  
  
Events & Workshop Management - 20%
  
  
Leads end-to-end logistical planning and execution of in-person and virtual events including founder workshops, speaker series, demo days, and community gatherings. Owns project timelines, vendor contracts, budget tracking, venue coordination, and post-event evaluation; applies findings to continuously improve event operations.
  
  
Partnerships & Campus Collaborations - 25%
  
  
Serves as primary operational point of contact for industry partners, sponsors, and campus collaborators including schools, departments, research centers, and student organizations. Manages deliverable tracking, maintains partner records, and coordinates stewardship touchpoints. Develops and maintains organizational systems to support relationship management across a portfolio of external and campus partners; coordinates joint activities and ensures commitments are met on time.
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 10%
  
  
Manages operational administration of fellowship winners and grantees including building and tracking ongoing progress, support and introductions, and managing program reports. Develops and refines operational workflows to support program scalability.
  
  
Project Management & Organizational Systems - 10%
  
  
Maintains and continuously improves project management infrastructure including tracking tools, dashboards, status reports, and documentation systems. Develops standardized templates and operational playbooks to support consistent program delivery. Supports leadership with data organization and reporting for strategic planning purposes.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to build and manage operational systems, workflows, and tracking tools across multiple concurrent programs and projects.
  
Proficiency with project management methodologies and tools (e.g. Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or equivalent); ability to develop and maintain project plans, dashboards, and status reports.
  
Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a high degree of operational autonomy.
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with diverse audiences including startup founders, industry partners, campus collaborators, and university leadership.
  
Experience coordinating operational logistics for programs, events, or projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with a wide range of internal and external partners including campus departments, research centers, and industry organizations.
  
Ability to identify process inefficiencies and develop practical, scalable operational improvements and standard operating procedures.
  
Proficiency with Google Workspace and common collaboration and productivity platforms.
  
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality with sensitive institutional, partner, and program information.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Familiarity with the startup, venture, or innovation ecosystem, particularly in deep tech, life sciences, or climate technology

jobs.title: Planning & Operations Program Manager, Employee Experience & Productivity
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  
  
Employee Experience and Productivity (EEP) is part of IS&T and delivers some of the most widely used communication and productivity technology and services across Apple - from tools that enable collaboration to the support teams that keep Apple's workforce running. EEP also leads user experience design and research, and manages the systems behind Apple's original content studios.  
  
**Description**  
  
Our team is looking for a program manager to join this dynamic and fast paced environment. This role will provide day-to-day support for the Employee Experience & Productivity team. This position will help drive and own projects related to finance, headcount, operations, financial planning and analysis deliverables. We’re looking for someone that is comfortable managing multi year budgets, able to think critically, and has top-level finance knowledge. This position requires not only complete financial analyses, but also the ability to drive tangible operational results both within and outside of the organization.

**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $140,700 and $211,400, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Care Manager
jobs.description:
**Lead Caregiver Role**
=======================

The Lead Caregiver serves as a shift leader, ensuring high-quality, consistent resident care and supporting the caregiving team.
  
Responsibilities include managing shift assignments, attendance, and coverage, providing hands-on assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs), coaching caregivers on quality standards, reviewing charting to align with Individualized Service Plans (ISP), and monitoring resident health changes.
  
They support onboarding and mentor new team members, promote safety and compliance, and facilitate smooth shift transitions.
  
As both a working caregiver and frontline leader, they model professionalism, accountability, and compassionate service.

**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma/GED; age 18+
* CPR, First Aid, and Medication Administration certifications
* Strong communication, delegation, and decision-making skills
* Experience in assisted living, memory care, or senior care

**Key Skills and Duties:**
  
Leadership, caregiving expertise, resident monitoring, team mentorship, safety compliance, and effective communication.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily business functions across our retail locations. This pivotal role involves overseeing store operations, managing teams, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate will be passionate about retail management, possess strong leadership skills, and have a comprehensive understanding of operational processes including inventory control, sales management, and staff training. Your energetic approach will drive store performance, foster a positive work environment, and ensure operational excellence at every level.

**Duties**

* Lead and supervise retail staff, including hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing development to cultivate a high-performing team.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure smooth workflow.
* Manage sales strategies by monitoring retail sales performance, setting targets, and implementing promotional activities to boost revenue.
* Coordinate purchasing and pricing decisions to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs and maximizing profitability.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions and facilitate ongoing training on customer service excellence, product knowledge, and operational procedures.
* Implement effective management of payroll, bookkeeping, budgeting, and administrative tasks to support store efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and legal regulations while maintaining excellent customer service standards.
* Utilize strong communication skills to manage shift schedules, supervise cashiering activities, and handle customer inquiries professionally.
* Drive marketing initiatives within the store to attract customers and increase sales through merchandising and promotional campaigns.
* Maintain organized records of inventory levels, sales data, employee performance metrics, and operational reports for continuous improvement.

**Experience**

* Proven management experience within the retail industry with a focus on sales team supervision and store operations management.
* Demonstrated proficiency in inventory management systems (POS systems), purchasing processes, and retail math for accurate pricing and stock control.
* Strong background in recruiting, interviewing candidates, employee orientation, training & development programs.
* Experience with payroll processing, bookkeeping practices, budgeting responsibilities, and cash handling procedures.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Bilingual or multilingual abilities are preferred to serve diverse customer bases effectively.
* Supervising experience in retail sales teams with a focus on customer service excellence is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with wireless sales or grocery store operations is a plus but not required.

Join us as an Operations Manager if you’re ready to lead with energy, inspire your team’s growth, and make a tangible impact on our store’s success!

Pay: $45.00 - $60.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Program Manager HCM (Workday)
jobs.description:
**Location and Remote Eligibility**

Fully remote candidates within the United States will be considered if they demonstrate substantial experience leading large-scale Workday implementations as a project manager, program manager, engagement manager, or delivery lead.

At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

**Position Description**
========================

Connect Centric is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) initiatives for our client, with a primary focus on UKG and Workday. You will oversee multiple HCM workstreams, connecting implementation plans, platform enhancements, integrations, reporting, governance, and operational readiness across the program.  
  
This role requires direct experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives.

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Lead complex, cross-functional HCM programs and projects involving UKG, Workday, and related workforce management capabilities.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, implementation roadmaps, schedules, milestones, budgets, dependencies, risks, and issues across HCM workstreams.
* Facilitate program governance and decision forums; prepare decision materials, document decisions, track actions, and provide status updates to senior leaders.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders, vendors, and workstream project managers to clarify scope, align priorities, resolve risks and issues, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Coordinate requirements, configuration decisions, business workflows, integrations, data validation, testing, and implementation readiness for UKG and Workday initiatives.
* Oversee cutover coordination, operational transition planning, and post-implementation stabilization across the HCM program.
* Prepare executive reports, dashboards, decision logs, and risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs; communicate delivery progress, tradeoffs, decisions, and adoption impacts.
* Support HCM process improvement, change management, stakeholder readiness, training coordination, and adoption planning.
* Develop and maintain program standards, templates, governance routines, tools, and delivery methodologies that improve consistency and readiness.
* Assess workforce processes, platform issues, data considerations, vendor capabilities, and platform roadmaps; recommend practical solutions to complex HCM challenges.
* Ensure work products meet business needs, quality expectations, compliance requirements, data integrity standards, configuration expectations, and delivery commitments.
* Balance competing HCM programs, platform enhancements, implementation activities, and stakeholder needs.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree and at least eight years of experience in program management, project management, business analysis, technology delivery, or a related field, including demonstrated experience supporting enterprise HCM platforms.
* Strong experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives, including implementation planning, enhancements, requirements definition, configuration coordination, business process alignment, and integration coordination.
* Experience coordinating HCM testing, data validation, security and access considerations, reporting, stakeholder readiness, training support, adoption, issue resolution, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Hands-on experience using UKG and Workday to support program delivery, platform reporting, issue tracking, stakeholder communications, governance, testing coordination, cutover planning, and executive decision support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex HCM programs or projects involving HR, payroll, finance, operations, technology teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of core HR, payroll, time and attendance, absence management, benefits, talent, workforce scheduling, reporting, and employee self-service processes.
* Strong understanding of scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, dependency, resource, change, benefits, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting Agile or other delivery methodologies in enterprise platform, ERP, HRIS, payroll, workforce management, or HCM environments.
* Experience preparing and presenting executive reports, dashboards, status updates, decision materials, risk summaries, and implementation readiness updates.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, Scrum, Prosci, ITIL, Workday, UKG, HRIS, or a similar certification.

**Position Details**

* Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.
* Location: Washington D.C. / Remote for Exceptional Candidates outside of commuting radius.
* This position is hybrid (2x per week)
* Pay Rate: $130K - $140K

jobs.title: Project Manager HCM Payroll (Workday)
jobs.description:
**Location and Remote Eligibility**

Fully remote candidates within the United States will be considered if they demonstrate substantial experience leading large-scale Workday implementations as a project manager, program manager, engagement manager, or delivery lead.

-  
At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.  
  
Position Description  
Connect Centric is seeking a Project Manager to manage the payroll workstream within our client’s enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) initiatives, with a primary focus on UKG and Workday. You will plan, coordinate, and track payroll deliverables, schedules, requirements, risks, testing, implementation readiness, cutover, and operational transition.  
  
This role requires direct experience supporting payroll initiatives involving both UKG and Workday. * Apply client-approved project standards, templates, governance routines, and delivery methods; follow client policies, confidentiality expectations, information security requirements, and applicable compliance standards.
* Assess payroll operations, workforce processes, data considerations, platform roadmaps, and vendor capabilities to recommend practical solutions and improvements.
* Help ensure deliverables meet business needs, quality expectations, compliance requirements, data integrity standards, configuration expectations, and delivery commitments while balancing enhancements, stakeholder requests, and deadlines.

jobs.title: Rheumatology Care Coordination Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

OC RHEUMATOLOGY is seeking a **Rheumatology Care Coordination Specialist** to support patients throughout the administrative and scheduling aspects of their specialty-care journey. This position coordinates referrals, appointments, records, authorizations, follow-up activities, and communication between patients, providers, and outside healthcare organizations.

The ideal candidate is organized, compassionate, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple patient coordination tasks while maintaining accurate documentation and confidentiality.

**Key ResponsibilitiesPatient Care Coordination**

* Coordinate patient appointments, follow-up visits, and specialty-care scheduling.
* Assist patients with navigating administrative steps related to rheumatology services.
* Monitor outstanding coordination tasks and follow up to help prevent delays in care.
* Maintain accurate patient contact and appointment information.
* Coordinate follow-up activities based on established provider and practice workflows.
* Communicate scheduling or administrative changes to patients promptly.

**Referral & Specialist Coordination**

* Process incoming and outgoing referrals according to established procedures.
* Coordinate appointments with referring providers and outside specialists.
* Track referral status and follow up on incomplete or pending referrals.
* Request and coordinate outside medical records and supporting documentation.
* Communicate with referring offices regarding scheduling and administrative requirements.
* Maintain accurate referral tracking records.

**Authorization & Administrative Support**

* Assist with insurance authorization and administrative requirements when applicable.
* Track pending authorization requests and required documentation.
* Communicate authorization-related status updates to appropriate internal team members.
* Identify missing information that could delay scheduling or administrative processing.
* Escalate complex authorization or coverage questions to the appropriate billing, insurance, or clinical team.

**Patient Communication**

* Respond to patient calls, messages, and administrative questions professionally.
* Provide appointment details, scheduling information, and general practice-approved instructions.
* Assist patients with rescheduling, cancellations, and appointment coordination.
* Communicate next administrative steps clearly and courteously.
* Maintain a patient-centered approach when handling concerns or service issues.

**Records & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate referral, scheduling, and coordination records.
* Track outside records and documentation requests.
* Enter and update information in EHR and practice-management systems.
* Ensure coordination notes and administrative records are complete and organized.
* Protect confidential patient information in accordance with practice policies and applicable privacy requirements.

**Provider & Team Coordination**

* Communicate with physicians, clinical staff, front-office personnel, billing staff, and outside offices.
* Help coordinate information needed for upcoming appointments.
* Identify scheduling conflicts, missing documentation, or other administrative barriers.
* Keep appropriate team members informed about unresolved coordination issues.
* Support efficient patient flow and specialty-care operations.

**Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Maintain referral and care-coordination tracking reports.
* Monitor outstanding tasks, appointment delays, and recurring administrative issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve referral and scheduling workflows.
* Assist with developing consistent administrative procedures.
* Support management with basic operational reporting as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of experience in healthcare administration, patient access, referral coordination, medical scheduling, care coordination, or a related field.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple patient coordination tasks and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
* Comfortable using EHR, practice-management, scheduling, email, and office software.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and handle sensitive information professionally.

**Preferred**

* Experience in rheumatology, internal medicine, primary care, or another specialty medical practice.
* Experience coordinating referrals and outside medical records.
* Familiarity with prior authorization processes.
* Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, or managed-care plans.
* Knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare administrative workflows.
* Experience with EHR/practice-management systems.
* Associate degree or coursework in healthcare administration, medical office administration, or a related field.
* Bilingual communication skills are a plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Patient coordination
* Referral management
* Appointment scheduling
* Healthcare administration
* Patient communication
* Documentation accuracy
* Insurance/authorization coordination
* EHR proficiency
* Organization and prioritization
* Problem solving
* Confidentiality
* Cross-functional teamwork

Pay: $26.14 - $31.48 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.description:
Program & Project Coordinator (5257C), Bakar ClimatEnginuity Hub - #89253 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
Bakar Labs is the consortium of biotech and climate tech incubators made up of four locations: Bakar Bio Labs at Berkeley, Bakar Bio Labs at UCSF, Bakar Labs for Energy and Materials, and the IGI-Bakar Labs Expansion.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
As Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials expands towards opening a new incubator facility in mid-2028, the Program & Project Coordinator works closely with a team of three to provide entrepreneurship programming and recruit early-stage energy and materials companies for a pilot program. This position applies project management and analytical skills to oversee the day-to-day administration and execution of Bakar Labs for Energy & Materials initiatives, including fellowship programs, events, workshops, and campus/industry partnerships.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
**The First Review Date for this job is:** October 16, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Program Operations & Administration - 35%
  
  
Manages day-to-day operational coordination of Bakar Labs programs, including developing and maintaining program systems, tracking milestones and deliverables, organizing scheduling across multiple concurrent activities, and managing founder and participant communications. Proactively identifies operational bottlenecks and implements process improvements to enhance program efficiency and participant experience.
  
  
Events & Workshop Management - 20%
  
  
Leads end-to-end logistical planning and execution of in-person and virtual events including founder workshops, speaker series, demo days, and community gatherings. Owns project timelines, vendor contracts, budget tracking, venue coordination, and post-event evaluation; applies findings to continuously improve event operations.
  
  
Partnerships & Campus Collaborations - 25%
  
  
Serves as primary operational point of contact for industry partners, sponsors, and campus collaborators including schools, departments, research centers, and student organizations. Manages deliverable tracking, maintains partner records, and coordinates stewardship touchpoints. Develops and maintains organizational systems to support relationship management across a portfolio of external and campus partners; coordinates joint activities and ensures commitments are met on time.
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 10%
  
  
Manages operational administration of fellowship winners and grantees including building and tracking ongoing progress, support and introductions, and managing program reports. Develops and refines operational workflows to support program scalability.
  
  
Project Management & Organizational Systems - 10%
  
  
Maintains and continuously improves project management infrastructure including tracking tools, dashboards, status reports, and documentation systems. Develops standardized templates and operational playbooks to support consistent program delivery. Supports leadership with data organization and reporting for strategic planning purposes.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to build and manage operational systems, workflows, and tracking tools across multiple concurrent programs and projects.
  
Proficiency with project management methodologies and tools (e.g. Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or equivalent); ability to develop and maintain project plans, dashboards, and status reports.
  
Demonstrated ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with a high degree of operational autonomy.
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with diverse audiences including startup founders, industry partners, campus collaborators, and university leadership.
  
Experience coordinating operational logistics for programs, events, or projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent workstreams.
  
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with a wide range of internal and external partners including campus departments, research centers, and industry organizations.
  
Ability to identify process inefficiencies and develop practical, scalable operational improvements and standard operating procedures.
  
Proficiency with Google Workspace and common collaboration and productivity platforms.
  
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality with sensitive institutional, partner, and program information.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Familiarity with the startup, venture, or innovation ecosystem, particularly in deep tech, life sciences, or climate technology

IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  
  
Employee Experience and Productivity (EEP) is part of IS&T and delivers some of the most widely used communication and productivity technology and services across Apple - from tools that enable collaboration to the support teams that keep Apple's workforce running. EEP also leads user experience design and research, and manages the systems behind Apple's original content studios.  
  
**Description**  
  
Our team is looking for a program manager to join this dynamic and fast paced environment. This role will provide day-to-day support for the Employee Experience & Productivity team. This position will help drive and own projects related to finance, headcount, operations, financial planning and analysis deliverables. We’re looking for someone that is comfortable managing multi year budgets, able to think critically, and has top-level finance knowledge. This position requires not only complete financial analyses, but also the ability to drive tangible operational results both within and outside of the organization.

Experience handling multi year budgets

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and proactive Operations Manager to lead and optimize daily business functions across our retail locations. This pivotal role involves overseeing store operations, managing teams, and ensuring exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate will be passionate about retail management, possess strong leadership skills, and have a comprehensive understanding of operational processes including inventory control, sales management, and staff training. Your energetic approach will drive store performance, foster a positive work environment, and ensure operational excellence at every level.

**Duties**

* Lead and supervise retail staff, including hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing development to cultivate a high-performing team.
* Oversee daily store operations such as cash handling, POS system management, merchandising, stocking, and inventory control to ensure smooth workflow.
* Manage sales strategies by monitoring retail sales performance, setting targets, and implementing promotional activities to boost revenue.
* Coordinate purchasing and pricing decisions to maintain optimal stock levels while controlling costs and maximizing profitability.
* Conduct employee orientation sessions and facilitate ongoing training on customer service excellence, product knowledge, and operational procedures.
* Implement effective management of payroll, bookkeeping, budgeting, and administrative tasks to support store efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and legal regulations while maintaining excellent customer service standards.
* Utilize strong communication skills to manage shift schedules, supervise cashiering activities, and handle customer inquiries professionally.
* Drive marketing initiatives within the store to attract customers and increase sales through merchandising and promotional campaigns.
* Maintain organized records of inventory levels, sales data, employee performance metrics, and operational reports for continuous improvement.

**Experience**

* Proven management experience within the retail industry with a focus on sales team supervision and store operations management.
* Demonstrated proficiency in inventory management systems (POS systems), purchasing processes, and retail math for accurate pricing and stock control.
* Strong background in recruiting, interviewing candidates, employee orientation, training & development programs.
* Experience with payroll processing, bookkeeping practices, budgeting responsibilities, and cash handling procedures.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Bilingual or multilingual abilities are preferred to serve diverse customer bases effectively.
* Supervising experience in retail sales teams with a focus on customer service excellence is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with wireless sales or grocery store operations is a plus but not required.

Join us as an Operations Manager if you’re ready to lead with energy, inspire your team’s growth, and make a tangible impact on our store’s success!

Pay: $45.00 - $60.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Program Manager HCM (Workday)
new_jobs.description:
**Location and Remote Eligibility**

Fully remote candidates within the United States will be considered if they demonstrate substantial experience leading large-scale Workday implementations as a project manager, program manager, engagement manager, or delivery lead.

At Connect Centric, we are more than just consultants—we are partners committed to our clients' success. We take a hands-on approach, working closely with our clients to transform strategies into measurable, real-world outcomes. As a strategy execution team, we take full ownership of every initiative from start to finish, ensuring that our clients see tangible results, not just ideas.

**Position Description**
========================

Connect Centric is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead enterprise Human Capital Management (HCM) initiatives for our client, with a primary focus on UKG and Workday. You will oversee multiple HCM workstreams, connecting implementation plans, platform enhancements, integrations, reporting, governance, and operational readiness across the program.  
  
This role requires direct experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives.

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Lead complex, cross-functional HCM programs and projects involving UKG, Workday, and related workforce management capabilities.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, implementation roadmaps, schedules, milestones, budgets, dependencies, risks, and issues across HCM workstreams.
* Facilitate program governance and decision forums; prepare decision materials, document decisions, track actions, and provide status updates to senior leaders.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders, vendors, and workstream project managers to clarify scope, align priorities, resolve risks and issues, and maintain delivery momentum.
* Coordinate requirements, configuration decisions, business workflows, integrations, data validation, testing, and implementation readiness for UKG and Workday initiatives.
* Oversee cutover coordination, operational transition planning, and post-implementation stabilization across the HCM program.
* Prepare executive reports, dashboards, decision logs, and risk, assumption, issue, and dependency (RAID) logs; communicate delivery progress, tradeoffs, decisions, and adoption impacts.
* Support HCM process improvement, change management, stakeholder readiness, training coordination, and adoption planning.
* Develop and maintain program standards, templates, governance routines, tools, and delivery methodologies that improve consistency and readiness.
* Assess workforce processes, platform issues, data considerations, vendor capabilities, and platform roadmaps; recommend practical solutions to complex HCM challenges.
* Ensure work products meet business needs, quality expectations, compliance requirements, data integrity standards, configuration expectations, and delivery commitments.
* Balance competing HCM programs, platform enhancements, implementation activities, and stakeholder needs.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree and at least eight years of experience in program management, project management, business analysis, technology delivery, or a related field, including demonstrated experience supporting enterprise HCM platforms.
* Strong experience supporting both UKG and Workday initiatives, including implementation planning, enhancements, requirements definition, configuration coordination, business process alignment, and integration coordination.
* Experience coordinating HCM testing, data validation, security and access considerations, reporting, stakeholder readiness, training support, adoption, issue resolution, and post-implementation stabilization.
* Hands-on experience using UKG and Workday to support program delivery, platform reporting, issue tracking, stakeholder communications, governance, testing coordination, cutover planning, and executive decision support.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex HCM programs or projects involving HR, payroll, finance, operations, technology teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
* Working knowledge of core HR, payroll, time and attendance, absence management, benefits, talent, workforce scheduling, reporting, and employee self-service processes.
* Strong understanding of scope, schedule, budget, risk, issue, dependency, resource, change, benefits, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting Agile or other delivery methodologies in enterprise platform, ERP, HRIS, payroll, workforce management, or HCM environments.
* Experience preparing and presenting executive reports, dashboards, status updates, decision materials, risk summaries, and implementation readiness updates.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, Scrum, Prosci, ITIL, Workday, UKG, HRIS, or a similar certification.

**Position Details**

* Position Type: Full-time W-2 employment. Independent contractor or 1099 arrangements are not available for this position.
* Location: Washington D.C. / Remote for Exceptional Candidates outside of commuting radius.
* This position is hybrid (2x per week)
* Pay Rate: $130K - $140K

new_jobs.title: Rheumatology Care Coordination Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

OC RHEUMATOLOGY is seeking a **Rheumatology Care Coordination Specialist** to support patients throughout the administrative and scheduling aspects of their specialty-care journey. This position coordinates referrals, appointments, records, authorizations, follow-up activities, and communication between patients, providers, and outside healthcare organizations.

The ideal candidate is organized, compassionate, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple patient coordination tasks while maintaining accurate documentation and confidentiality.

**Key ResponsibilitiesPatient Care Coordination**

* Coordinate patient appointments, follow-up visits, and specialty-care scheduling.
* Assist patients with navigating administrative steps related to rheumatology services.
* Monitor outstanding coordination tasks and follow up to help prevent delays in care.
* Maintain accurate patient contact and appointment information.
* Coordinate follow-up activities based on established provider and practice workflows.
* Communicate scheduling or administrative changes to patients promptly.

**Referral & Specialist Coordination**

* Process incoming and outgoing referrals according to established procedures.
* Coordinate appointments with referring providers and outside specialists.
* Track referral status and follow up on incomplete or pending referrals.
* Request and coordinate outside medical records and supporting documentation.
* Communicate with referring offices regarding scheduling and administrative requirements.
* Maintain accurate referral tracking records.

**Authorization & Administrative Support**

* Assist with insurance authorization and administrative requirements when applicable.
* Track pending authorization requests and required documentation.
* Communicate authorization-related status updates to appropriate internal team members.
* Identify missing information that could delay scheduling or administrative processing.
* Escalate complex authorization or coverage questions to the appropriate billing, insurance, or clinical team.

**Patient Communication**

* Respond to patient calls, messages, and administrative questions professionally.
* Provide appointment details, scheduling information, and general practice-approved instructions.
* Assist patients with rescheduling, cancellations, and appointment coordination.
* Communicate next administrative steps clearly and courteously.
* Maintain a patient-centered approach when handling concerns or service issues.

**Records & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate referral, scheduling, and coordination records.
* Track outside records and documentation requests.
* Enter and update information in EHR and practice-management systems.
* Ensure coordination notes and administrative records are complete and organized.
* Protect confidential patient information in accordance with practice policies and applicable privacy requirements.

**Provider & Team Coordination**

* Communicate with physicians, clinical staff, front-office personnel, billing staff, and outside offices.
* Help coordinate information needed for upcoming appointments.
* Identify scheduling conflicts, missing documentation, or other administrative barriers.
* Keep appropriate team members informed about unresolved coordination issues.
* Support efficient patient flow and specialty-care operations.

**Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Maintain referral and care-coordination tracking reports.
* Monitor outstanding tasks, appointment delays, and recurring administrative issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve referral and scheduling workflows.
* Assist with developing consistent administrative procedures.
* Support management with basic operational reporting as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of experience in healthcare administration, patient access, referral coordination, medical scheduling, care coordination, or a related field.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Ability to manage multiple patient coordination tasks and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
* Comfortable using EHR, practice-management, scheduling, email, and office software.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and handle sensitive information professionally.

**Preferred**

* Experience in rheumatology, internal medicine, primary care, or another specialty medical practice.
* Experience coordinating referrals and outside medical records.
* Familiarity with prior authorization processes.
* Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance, or managed-care plans.
* Knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare administrative workflows.
* Experience with EHR/practice-management systems.
* Associate degree or coursework in healthcare administration, medical office administration, or a related field.
* Bilingual communication skills are a plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Patient coordination
* Referral management
* Appointment scheduling
* Healthcare administration
* Patient communication
* Documentation accuracy
* Insurance/authorization coordination
* EHR proficiency
* Organization and prioritization
* Problem solving
* Confidentiality
* Cross-functional teamwork

Pay: $26.14 - $31.48 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
